anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex arc forming the dorsal-anterior cranial profile with a large radius curvature.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportionally short and thick beak structure with low longitudinal extension relative to the cranial height.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point where the melon curve meets the dorsal rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, circular depigmented markings and small light-colored spots visible on the lateral skin surface of the melon and mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent eye with visible iris and a distinct horizontal gape line extending posteriorly from the rostrum base.
